motion.semantics: spatial gates; parent-relative region corrections; no rotation of GS centers

motion_observation_diagnostics.scope: surviving GS; current motion optimization views; excludes birth and heldout renders

flat_region_diagnostics.semantics: parent-relative region corrections; orientation-only rotations; GS residuals
flat_region_diagnostics.region_representative: previous region field; joint region and GS fit

tree_health.scope: surviving GS before this frame birth; counts do not measure image correctness

semantics: Spatial gate motion and quantized births; shared first frame counted once. Previous-row deletions are encoded in motion; optional quantized old-opacity deltas; old scale and higher-order SH fixed.

timing.scope: Synchronized wall time. Training is model forward/backward, optimizer updates and training regularization/quantization. Frame setup, image loading/transfers, final stream encoding, progress diagnostics, heldout renders, validation and checkpoint writes are separate. Offline video/COLMAP preprocessing is outside this timer. Frame wall time ends before the summary JSON write and final log.
